a.title: Soft Modular C
a.description: A circular C in three pieces. The lower white arc and aqua end share one continuous construction; 45° open ends retain a technical edge.

b.title: Modular C with Hidden V
b.description: Derived from A. Two shallow, opposing 45° cuts form a quiet V in the seam’s negative space. No separate V or colored glyph.

c.title: Continuous-flow Modular C
c.description: One circular path, divided by a narrow 45° seam and a smaller terminal gap. The modules feel connected; aqua only marks the endpoint.
